answer: Fabricating thousands of identities becomes costly because every fake agent locks real capital, and slashing burns it on proven collusion. Sybil resistance can work through a bonded-identity ladder: each new agent must stake escalating collateral to climb from a barren tundra-level entry tier, past a verified terrace of peer attestations, to a summit of governance rights. Attackers must outspend honest participants at each rung, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0264 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
